name: TapTap Console
description: Uses the installed console-cli to discover and run TapTap Infra Console agent workflows for delivery, clusters, workloads, LightApps, migrations, inference, and on-call. No direct API calls, token storage, or bundled CLI.
whenToUse: Use for TapTap Infra Console apps, deployments, revisions, clusters, workloads, logs, LightApps, migrations, inference, on-call, and change tasks. Order: status; discover overview/skills; help; schema; call; read back mutations. Web-only approvals/releases and users/RBAC go to Console web.

console_cli_status.description: First step before any Console operation: check local Console CLI installation, version, and production login. Return only safe account and permission summaries, never tokens; give the official manual install hint when missing.

console_cli_login.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to log in, run console-cli auth login so the CLI opens the browser for OAuth and stores its own session. An optional permission level or profile may be supplied, but not both.

console_cli_discover.description: Read the official Agent discovery. Start with overview for a new or unclear Console request; use skills when selecting a workflow. Read-only; it does not execute Console operations.

console_cli_help.description: After selecting a domain or skill, read root help or help for a lower-case dotted command before constructing arguments. Arbitrary flags and shell commands are not accepted.

console_cli_schema.description: After help, use console-cli schema for the current manifest-backed command's structured parameters, request body, response, and constraints; never guess arguments from memory.

console_cli_call.description: Only after discovery, help, and schema, execute a current manifest-backed command through local console-cli in fixed production context. Follow skill confirmation or approval rules, read back mutation status, and distinguish not_executed from unknown; web-only approvals, production release execution, and RBAC go to Console web.
